name: Wednesdays
source:
Like so many children, Tim was a victim of sexual abuse.

Twenty years later, while playing Orco Park, a video game from his childhood, his memories will come rushing back along with a flood of questions: How could this have happened? Who knew? How has it shaped him? What does “normal” even mean?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
和许许多多孩子一样，蒂姆也曾是儿童性侵的受害者。

二十年后，当他重温儿时玩过的电子游戏《奥尔科乐园》（Orco Park）时，尘封的记忆连同汹涌的追问一同翻涌而回：这一切当年究竟为何会发生？都有谁知情？这段经历塑造了怎样的他？而所谓的“正常”，又究竟意味着什么？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747770/]Steam[/url]]
